INSERT INTO order_item (id, order_id, seller_id, seller_order_id, spu_id, sku_id, product_name, product_image, price, quantity, total_price) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.sellerId}, #{item.sellerOrderId}, #{item.spuId}, #{item.skuId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.productImage}, #{item.price}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.totalPrice})
mapper.sql: COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_image), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(sku.images), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(spu.main_image), ''), spu.images) AS product_image
mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.seller_id, oi.seller_order_id, oi.spu_id, oi.sku_id, oi.product_name, , oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.shipped_quantity, oi.refunded_quantity, oi.shipping_company, oi.tracking_no, oi.ship_time, oi.total_price FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = oi.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = oi.spu_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.seller_id, oi.seller_order_id, oi.spu_id, oi.sku_id, oi.product_name, , oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.shipped_quantity, oi.refunded_quantity, oi.shipping_company, oi.tracking_no, oi.ship_time, oi.total_price FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = oi.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = oi.spu_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} AND oi.seller_id = #{sellerId}

SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.seller_id, oi.seller_order_id, oi.spu_id, oi.sku_id, oi.product_name, , oi.price, oi.quantity, oi.shipped_quantity, oi.refunded_quantity, oi.shipping_company, oi.tracking_no, oi.ship_time, oi.total_price FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = oi.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_spu spu ON spu.id = oi.spu_id WHERE oi.seller_order_id = #{sellerOrderId} AND oi.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY oi.id
